an8.23:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā āḷaviyaṃ viharati aggāḷave cetiye.
an8.23:1.3: sattahi bhikkhave, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhāretha.
an8.23:1.12: imehi kho bhikkhave, sattahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhārethāti,
an8.23:1.14: idaṃ vatvā sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an8.23:2.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena hatthakassa āḷavakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.23:2.2: atha kho hatthako āḷavako yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ so bhikkhu etadavoca:
an8.23:3.1: sattahi kho tvaṃ āvuso, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā vyākato.
an8.23:3.10: imehi kho tvaṃ āvuso, sattahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā vyākatoti.
an8.23:3.11: kaccittha bhante, na koci gihī ahosi odātavasanoti?
an8.23:3.12: na khottha āvuso, koci gihī ahosi odātavasanoti.
an8.23:3.13: sādhu bhante, yadettha na koci gihī ahosi odātavasanoti.
an8.23:4.1: atha kho so bhikkhu hatthakassa āḷavakassa nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an8.23:4.2: atha kho so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.23:5.1: idhāhaṃ bhante, pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena hatthakassa āḷavakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃ.
an8.23:5.2: atha kho bhante hatthako āḷavako yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi:
an8.23:5.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ etadavocaṃ.
an8.23:5.4: sattahi kho tvaṃ āvuso, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā vyākato.
an8.23:5.13: imehi kho tvaṃ āvuso, sattahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā vyākatoti.
an8.23:6.1: evaṃ vutte bhante, hatthako āḷavako maṃ etadavoca:
an8.23:6.2: kaccittha bhante, na koci gihī ahosi odātavasanoti.
an8.23:6.3: na khottha āvuso, koci gihī ahosi odāta vasanoti.
an8.23:6.4: sādhu bhante, yadettha na koci gihī ahosi odātavasanoti.
an8.23:7.3: santeyeva attani kusale dhamme na icchati parehi ñāyamāne,
an8.23:7.4: tena hi tvaṃ bhikkhu, imināpi aṭṭhamena acchariyena abbhutena dhammena samannāgataṃ hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhārehi yadidaṃ appicchatāyāti.
